inclusion_criteria: HER2-positive advanced/metastatic breast cancer (mBC)
Disease progression under trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) in the metastatic setting
Willingness and ability to undergo a baseline tumour biopsy
Willingness and ability to provide blood samples at pre‑specified time points
Willingness and ability to undergo baseline FDG‑PET/CT and 89Zr‑trastuzumab PET/CT (HER2‑PET/CT)
Ability to receive T‑DM1 monotherapy if classified as HER2‑PET/CT positive
Ability to receive treatment of physician's choice if classified as HER2‑PET/CT negative
Willingness to comply with study procedures, including metabolic evaluations and blood sampling
ECOG performance status ≤ 1

Must have histologically or cytologically confirmed progressive advanced/metastatic HER2-positive breast carcinoma as per the updated ASCO‑CAP guidelines according to local testing; HER2 status may be determined in the primary tumor or, when not available, in a metastatic lesion
Multifocal unilateral or bilateral breast adenocarcinoma tumours are allowed if all tested HER2-positive according to local testing
Prior treatment with taxane, trastuzumab and pertuzumab (early or advanced setting) and T-DXd (metastatic setting)
Must have received T-DXd as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and presented disease progression on this drug

Prior therapy with tucatinib, trastuzumab, and capecitabine in the advanced setting is permissible, provided that T-DXd serves as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and the patient presented disease progression on this drug
Life expectancy ≥ 6 months
At screening FDG-PET, at least two target lesions are required
Each target lesion must have an anatomic transaxial diameter ≥ 1.5 cm
Each target lesion must be metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean
Lesion anatomically transaxial diameter ≤ 1.5 cm.
Lesion metabolically assessable with SUVmax ≤ 1.5 × SUVmean + 2 SD of the liver measured in a 3‑cm‑diameter spherical VOI in normal liver parenchyma.
For suspected liver metastasis, lesion SUVmax ≤ 2 × SUVmean + 3 SD of the blood pool measured in a 1‑cm‑diameter VOI within descending thoracic aorta.
Lesions pre‑treated with irradiation are not eligible as “target” lesions.
Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) ≥ 1000/μL or ≥ 1×10¹/L.
Platelet count ≥ 100,000/μL or ≥ 100 × 10⁹/L.
Hemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL.
Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN) or estimated creatinine clearance ≥ 60 mL/min.
Total serum bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN unless the patient has documented Gilbert syndrome.
AST and ALT ≤ 2.5 × ULN.
Current left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥ 50% on echocardiography or MUGA and no history of LVEF < 40%, symptomatic heart failure, or recent myocardial infarction.
Willingness to provide tumour tissue (mandatory biopsy) for translational research.
Willingness to provide blood samples (mandatory) for translational research.
Willingness to comply with the protocol for the duration of the study including treatment and scheduled visits and examinations.
Signed informed consent form obtained prior to any study‑related procedure.
Affiliated to the French Social Security System (applicable to France only).
Subjects classified as HER2 PET/CT positive (the entire or majority of the tumour load shows significant tracer uptake)
Subjects classified as HER2 PET/CT negative (the dominant part or all of the tumour load lacks significant tracer uptake)
exclusion_criteria: Prior exposure to T‑DM1 for treatment of metastatic breast cancer.
Prior exposure to T‑DM1 for early breast cancer with relapse while on or within 12 months of finishing treatment with T‑DM1.
Brain metastasis as sole metastasis.
Symptomatic brain metastasis or brain metastasis requiring therapy to control symptoms.
History of interstitial lung disease/pneumonitis grade 3 or 4 during prior treatment with T‑DXd.
Significant symptoms (Grade ≥ 2) relating to left‑ventricular dysfunction, cardiac arrhythmia, or cardiac ischemia while or since receiving preoperative therapy.
Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic > 180 mmHg and/or diastolic > 100 mmHg).
Inadequately controlled angina, serious cardiac arrhythmia not controlled by medication, severe conduction abnormality, or clinically significant valvular disease.
Screening LVEF < 50% by either echocardiography or MUGA.
History of Grade ≥ 3 symptomatic congestive heart failure (CHF) or NYHA class ≥ II.
History of a decrease in LVEF to < 40% or symptomatic CHF with prior trastuzumab treatment.
Myocardial infarction within 12 months prior to randomization.
Requirement for continuous oxygen therapy.
Known prior severe hypersensitivity to the investigational product or any component of its formulation, including severe hypersensitivity reactions to trastuzumab or excipients.
Contra‑indication for treatment with T‑DM1.
Progression within the first 6 months of T‑DXd therapy after the first 7 rapid progressors have been enrolled (capped at 10% of total enrollment).
Any known liver disease, including known carriers of hepatitis B virus, hepatitis C, autoimmune hepatic disorders and sclerosing cholangitis
Concurrent, serious, uncontrolled infections or known infection with HIV
Prior history of other invasive cancer in the past 5 years except basal or squamous cell carcinoma of skin that has been definitively treated
Pregnant and/or lactating women, or intending to become pregnant during the study
Serum pregnancy test (for subjects of childbearing potential) positive within 15 days prior to enrolment

Women of childbearing potential refusing to use one highly effective method of contraception from ICF signature, during the course of the study and at least 7 months after the last administration of T-DM1
Men with childbearing potential partner refusing to use condom during the course of this study and for at least 7 months after the last administration of T-DM1

Subject with a significant medical, neuro‑psychiatric, or surgical condition, currently uncontrolled by treatment, which, in the principal investigator's opinion, may interfere with completion of the study
Progression within the first 6 months of T‑DXd therapy (after the first 7 rapid progressors have been included)

Vulnerable persons according to article L.1121‑6 of the Public Health Code, adults who are the subject of a measure of legal protection or unable to express their consent according to article L.1121‑8 of the Public Health Code (applicable to France only)
